title: `engram backup status --check-target`: typed confirmation, guarded recording, and the window test
outcome: `engram backup status --check-target`: typed confirmation, guarded recording, and the window test
acceptance: A check records its result only under the push lock and only when the newest receipt is still the one it checked; a test lets a push record a newer receipt between the check's read and its write and shows the check record nothing

A test moves the clock past the window with no new push and shows the mode change from `local_backed_up` to `local` with `backup_confirmation_expired`; after `status --check-target` then confirms that old copy without a new capture, the reason reads `backup_stale`

`engram backup status --check-target` asks the adapter to confirm under a deadline: a copy the target no longer holds is recorded and reads `backup_copy_missing` at once; an unreachable target is reported as `backup_target_unreachable`, and a check that reached the target and passed its deadline before it had read the copy as `backup_check_timed_out`, each beside the recorded evidence without changing it; a test covers each of the three

completion.summary: `engram backup status --check-target [--check-deadline-secs N]`: typed adapter confirmation (Unreachable, TimedOut, Unknown), guarded recording under the push lock only when identity, newest receipt and evidence are unchanged, the window test, and docs.
